s1.text:
1 · Where today's board misleads

• 6 rows say landing, but none is moving. The ◐ half-moon reads as halfway there.
• '12 of 23 checks passed' hides the 11 that failed.
• STARTS says 'started' and SHIPS says '—' for a PR that has sat for a day.
• The header says 2 need you. In reality 5 do.
• The ticket page knows (prMerge says 'Needs you'), but the row doesn't.

s2.text:
2 · Gaps in the approved spec

• Stuck and Needs you are both 'until someone acts', and you're the only someone. The #698 Flows image shows up in both.
• Stuck takes the grey of today's 'blocked'.
• A red PR in the driver's rerun window has no group.
• A queued fix shows as Fixing while the pace gate holds it.
• Merging doesn't say whether anything will merge it.
• No AC2 string covers a draft with red checks (#705).

s3.text:
3 · What changes

• Stuck folds into Needs you. Each row gives the reason, then the command.
• A red PR goes back to a worker: Running while one holds it, Ready while it waits for one.
• Merging includes reruns (red, named, 'rerun 1 of 2').
• STARTS and SHIPS show how long a row has been in its group, and when it moves next.
• A ticket behind a PR that needs you waits, so it's counted once.
• The header counts actions, and puts them first.

s4.text:
4 · Built into the state model

• Fix loop in pass.mjs, so the supervisor and the interactive orchestrator both get it.
• A Merging row that hasn't changed in 2h turns amber and goes into the digest.
• A review with P0 or P1 findings goes back to a worker, not to you.
• An unreadable verdict needs you: it's config, not code.
